hero.title: Integrated business solutions for small and medium businesses.
hero.lead: A study before you decide, a website and system to run your business, and marketing that brings in customers. All from one team, instead of juggling a consultant, a developer and an ad agency.

integrated.label: Integrated Business Solutions
integrated.title: What do we mean by integrated?
integrated.p1: A business owner isn't looking for a single, separate service. They want the business to work. A problem may start in pricing and show up in sales; a website may be good, yet nobody finds it.
integrated.p2: So we look at the whole business first, then deliver what it needs across consulting, digital solutions and marketing, with one team that knows the details from day one.

points.title: One point of contact
points.body: You work with one team from the first meeting to delivery, and never explain your situation twice.

points.title: One connected plan
points.body: What we recommend in the study is what we build on the website and run in marketing.

points.title: One clear proposal
points.body: You get a written proposal covering everything you need, with its scope and cost.

services.label: Services
services.title: Three departments, working together
services.lead: Start with any department. If your business needs more, the other two are ready.

items.title: You tell us what you need
items.body: Through the form or WhatsApp. You don't need to know the service name; just describe the situation.

items.title: We review and send a proposal
items.body: We review your request, may ask for a short call, then send a written proposal with scope and cost.

items.title: We deliver
items.body: Work starts once you approve, and we keep you updated until delivery.

consulting.name: Consulting
consulting.homeDesc: When you need to know before you decide: is the project viable? Why did sales drop? How do you organise the work so it doesn't depend on one person?
consulting.aboutDesc: Feasibility studies, business plans, business diagnosis and operations design.

hero.title: Before you invest, know where your business stands.
hero.lead: We review your business by the numbers, tell you plainly what works and what needs to change, then build a plan with you that you can actually carry out.

consulting.servicesTitle: Choose what fits the stage your business is in
consulting.stepsTitle: From the first session to the final recommendation

steps.title: Introductory session
steps.body: We listen to your situation and goals, and agree on the right service and scope.

steps.title: Research and analysis
steps.body: We gather and analyse the data, and check in with you along the way.

steps.title: Delivery and recommendations
steps.body: We walk you through the findings, with clear practical next steps.

faq.q: Do I need to know which service I need before contacting you?
faq.a: No. Tell us about your situation and where you want to get to, and we'll find the right service together.
Once we understand what you need, we send a written proposal with scope and cost before we start.

faq.q: Can you help implement after the study?
faq.a: Yes. Our digital and marketing teams can carry out the recommendations with you, from one place.
Yes. We treat all client data and information as strictly confidential.

consulting.endTitle: Not sure which service fits? Start with an introductory session.

hero.eyebrow: Digital Solutions — We build your presence
hero.title: A website that introduces your business, and a system that runs it.

digital.servicesTitle: What do you need to build?
digital.stepsTitle: How we work on your digital project

faq.q: Do I own the website and its data after delivery?
faq.a: Yes. The website, its domain and its data belong to your business.

faq.q: Do you handle hosting and renewals?
faq.a: Yes. We can manage hosting, the domain and technical subscriptions for you, so you never have to track renewal dates.

faq.q: Will the website be in Arabic and English?
faq.a: Yes, we build in both languages whenever your business needs it.

faq.q: Can the website be connected to marketing?
faq.a: Yes. Our marketing team works on the same website, from ads to tracking results.

hero.label: About
hero.title: ASCENDRA is an Integrated Business Solutions company in Riyadh.
hero.lead: We work with small and medium businesses across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, delivering consulting, digital solutions and marketing under one roof.

story.label: Our story
story.title: Why we founded ASCENDRA
story.p1: A small business owner usually deals with several parties to get one thing done: a consultant writes the study, a developer builds the website, an agency runs the ads. Each works alone, and nobody sees the full picture.
story.p2: We founded ASCENDRA to bring those roles together. We understand the business first, then deliver what it needs with one plan and one team.

values.label: Our approach
values.title: What we commit to with every client

items.title: Understand before we build
items.body: We don't start any work before we understand the business, its customers and where it wants to go.

items.title: We say what we see
items.body: We tell you honestly what we see in your business, even when it isn't what you expect to hear.

items.title: A clear proposal from the start
items.body: You know the scope and cost before we begin, with no items appearing later.

items.title: Still here after delivery
items.body: We stay in touch after delivery for support and updates.

sections.p: We only collect what you send us yourself through the contact form, WhatsApp or email: your name, mobile number, email if you add it, and a note about your project.
We use this information only to reply to your request and contact you about it. We don't sell your data or share it with anyone for marketing.
We keep the information for as long as we are in contact or working with you, and you can ask us to delete it at any time.
For any question, or to ask us to delete your data, email us at the address shown at the bottom of the page.
